capabilities: Color list-item blocks by task and PRD state tags in Live Preview
Inherit states from ancestor list items with explicit child overrides
Define custom per-tag color rules via settings or a vault-root JSON file
Toggle rendering per file from the command palette
Adjust block opacity and optionally restore native tag pills
extras: Initial release available only on GitHub pending directory review; tested on desktop only (mobile, themes, and large documents untested). No network requests, no account, 0BSD license. Optional WeChat community is independent of the plugin.
problem: Obsidian shows tags only as plain pills and gives no per-item visual state for task or decision workflows inside nested lists.

relations.evidence: Build and ESLint configuration are adapted from the official Obsidian sample plugin

summary: Renders colored state blocks for task, PRD, and custom tags on editable nested list items in Live Preview, with parent-to-child inheritance.
